fusions.name: Tapped Echo
fusions.desc: Taps the staff on the ground. The sound deals 3 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, and each hit has a 30% chance to leave its target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Shriek Down the Bore
fusions.desc: Sends a shriek down the hollow staff at the first enemy within 8 tiles. It deals 26 damage and ignores armour, then echoes to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each echo at 60% of that.

fusions.name: Roosting Post
fusions.desc: Plants the staff upright for 12 seconds as a roost. Bats drop from it onto an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second, each bite with a 30% chance to leave it [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Answering Rap
fusions.desc: Every blow you avoid builds a stack on you, up to 3. At 3 they all spend at once: the staff strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (102% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
